provenanceNotes: Six original generated masters and six referenced-image lighting edits. No external stock photographs or third-party image inputs were used. No third-party asset attribution requirement introduced. Use is subject to the OpenAI terms applicable to the generating account. No claim of CC0 status, unique output or exclusive copyright.
processingNotes: Native tool outputs were approximately 1586×992 (some dark edits 1585×992), despite requesting 2560×1600. Slight centered normalization to 1600×1000 preserves common 16:10 crop. Thumbnails are dedicated 320×200 WebP exports. Files below 250KB are kept compact because smooth shapes and darker low-contrast detail compress efficiently.
